name: Flying Posters
description: An endless ring of posters that spins with scroll or drag, and every poster loops around as it passes the edges and comes back from the other side — with alternating columns, scroll lean and edge fade.
interactionNotes: The mouse wheel over the stage spins the posters (the page does not scroll), and dragging with the pointer or a finger does the same. Posters near either end of the stage loop around on a smooth curve and return from the other side; use `speed` for a continuous drift and `lean` to let them bend back on fast scroll. A short click on any poster is reported through `onItemClick`.

props.name: items
props.type: Array<string | { image: string; link?: string; alt?: string }>
props.description: The poster images; each is center-cropped to fill its frame and repeated to fill the view. The desktop demo supplies six local photos.

props.name: planeWidth
props.description: Width of each poster in pixels, at the default camera.

props.name: planeHeight
props.description: Height of each poster in pixels, at the default camera.

props.name: distortion
props.description: How much sooner one corner of a poster turns than the other corner; the same twist while passing, 0 to 10.

props.name: scrollEase
props.description: How quickly the posters catch up with the wheel and drag; a lower number means a longer glide (0.002 to 0.1).

props.name: cameraFov
props.description: Camera field of view in degrees; a wider angle means more distant.

props.name: cameraZ
props.description: Distance of the camera from the posters; a higher number makes the posters smaller and flatter, a lower number brings them closer with stronger perspective.

props.name: gap
props.description: Spacing between posters in pixels; the default comes from the base default spacing, which shifts with the camera.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of poster columns, 1 to 8.

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Spacing between columns in pixels.

props.name: alternate
props.description: Alternating columns move in the opposite direction.

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the posters in pixels.

props.name: rotation
props.description: How far each poster rotates while passing through view, in degrees.

props.name: axis
props.description: The axis the posters rotate around.

props.name: speed
props.description: Continuous drift in pixels per second when nobody is scrolling; a negative value drifts downward.

props.name: lean
props.description: How far the posters bend back on fast scroll, 0 to 2.

props.name: fade
props.description: The posters fade toward the top and bottom edges, 0 to 1.

props.name: shading
props.description: Rotated posters appear darker, 0 to 1.

props.name: wheel
props.description: The mouse wheel over the stage spins the posters.

props.name: drag
props.description: Dragging with the pointer or finger spins the posters.

props.name: pageScroll
props.description: The posters move along with the page's own scroll; the displacement multiplier. Zero means off.

props.name: onItemClick
props.description: Called on a click or a short tap on a poster.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra class for the root.

props.name: style
props.description: Inline style for the root.

tips: No dependencies at all: a WebGL2 program, a texture atlas of all the images, and every poster drawn with `drawElementsInstanced` in a single call.
The mouse wheel over the canvas does not scroll the page and spins the posters instead; for normal page scrolling, move the pointer off the canvas.
Several columns with `columns` plus alternating columns (`alternate`) give a gallery-wall feel; for real portrait posters make `planeHeight` larger than `planeWidth`.
Under `prefers-reduced-motion` the drift and lean are off and the fade-in is instant; manual dragging stays available.
If WebGL2 is unavailable, the stage stays silent — the default behaves the same way.
